description: Discover the best hotels in Paros, Greece. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Paros Adults-Only Clifftop Glamour with Onsite Restaurants, Bar & Outdoor Pool
hotels.description: Perched on Paros’ rugged cliffs above the Aegean, this retreat pairs Cycladic minimalism with uninterrupted sea views from a collection of boutique suites and villas. A serene pool faces the horizon, and the refined Lenea restaurant serves contemporary Mediterranean plates shaped by island produce. A spa and fitness studio offer restorative treatments and ocean-facing workouts. Golden sand beaches and the sheltered coves of Monastiri sit within easy reach. In Naoussa, dine on just-landed seafood at Barbarossa, or head to the Port of Parikia’s waterfront promenade for late-night gelato and artisan boutiques.

hotels.title: Greece: Oceanside Paros Elegance in the Heart of Naousa with Pool & Bistro
hotels.description: Tucked into the heart of Naousa - Paros' most charming harbour village - Meros, Santikos Collection is a boutique retreat with effortless elegance. With just 26 rooms and suites, the property has the intimate feel of a private escape, with elegant Cycladic interiors, private balconies and sea views that make it easy to lose track of time. Rooms range from classic doubles to signature suites with outdoor heated tubs, each designed to blend clean contemporary style with the whitewashed beauty of the Aegean. A curated breakfast, a pool to retreat to in the afternoon heat and warm, personalised service round out the experience. Outside the hotel, Naousa rewards exploration - its cobbled alleyways, waterfront tavernas, fishing boats and boutique shops are all just steps away, and the island's famous beaches and windmills are within easy reach.

hotels.vendor_name: Parian Chronicle Hotel Paros by Hyatt
hotels.title: Extended by Popular Demand: Paros Private Pool Paradise with Daily Breakfast & EUR100 Resort Credit
hotels.description: Wake to the scent of salt in the air as the sunlight catches the whitewashed curves and lush surrounds of Parian Chronicle Hotel Paros, a Destination by Hyatt Hotel. Expect days that drift between lazy swims in the Aegean and leisurely breakfasts in the shade, and evenings that soften into long dinners at Naao, where Cycladic flavours shine through every plate. Spend your afternoons between Paros Kite Beach and the large outdoor pool, with loungers that invite you to linger with a book or cocktail. Between treatments and wellness rituals at Nipson Spa and morning classes in the fitness studio, it’s easy to lose track of time and let each new day set its own, relaxed rhythm.

hotels.title: Exclusive Paros Private Pool Suites with Panoramic Views over Aegean Sea
hotels.description: Perched on a sun-drenched hilltop with sweeping views of the surrounding landscapes, this exclusive Paros retreat redefines luxury with just four elegantly designed suites, each featuring a sprawling private terrace and shimmering private pool. Blending Cycladic charm with contemporary sophistication, the serene setting invites you to unwind in absolute style. Explore Paros' traditional villages, pristine beaches like Golden Beach and Kolymbithres, tavernas and cafes, all within reach.

hotels.title: Idyllic Paros Private Pool Villas with Aegean Sea Views
hotels.description: Steeped in Cycladic charms and nestled along the sun-drenched shores of Paros, this private villa paradise blends timeless island luxury with modern style. Think milk-white hues, breezy, light-filled interiors, chic amenities, manicured Mediterranean gardens and shimmering private pools, all set against the azure backdrop of the Aegean Sea. Spend your days soaking up the sun from your villa's terrace, rustle up your favourite meals in the fully-equipped kitchen and witness captivating sunsets from your secluded hilltop spot on the island. When you're not beach-hopping or trying out a variety of water sports, walk along cobblestone streets and explore the historic port town of Parikia, a short drive away.
